context_requirements: Expression of GFPT1 and intact hexosamine biosynthetic pathway
Availability of glucose and glutamine for UDP-GlcNAc synthesis
Functional O-GlcNAc transferase and glycosylation machinery
Capacity to mount an ER stress / integrated stress response
falsifiers: No change in any of the listed UPR/ISR or cholesterol-synthesis landmark genes at 24 h in any line
Strong and consistent upregulation of cholesterol-synthesis genes at 24 h
Clear transcriptional response at 6 h that is not sustained or amplified at 24 h
No difference in response between HEPG2 and the other lines
